# Ali Naderi

> AI/ML engineer and systems architect from Iran. Built FIDO2 passwordless authentication at IDmelon from R&D and prototypes to production, and led its engineering team; designs and builds production platforms; researches deep learning for 3D automated breast ultrasound. MSc in Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Iran University of Science and Technology (IUST).

This is the personal site of Ali Naderi (Ali Naderi Parizi; GitHub: mralinp). It holds a blog, project write-ups, research, book reviews and a CV. Everything is written by Ali unless a post says otherwise. The full text of every page is in [llms-full.txt]({{ base }}/llms-full.txt).
